```{r}
sum_vector <- function(A, v){
  if(nrow(A) != length(v)){
    stop("hammer time")
  }
  for(n in 1:ncol(A)){
    A[,n] = A[,n] + v
  }
  
  return(A)
}
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
init_params <- function(input_layer_size, output_layer_size, hidden_layers_sizes){
  layers_sizes = c(input_layer_size, hidden_layers_sizes, output_layer_size)
  
  wlist <- list()
  blist <- list()
  aux = 0
  
  for(n in 1:(length(layers_sizes)-1)){
    wlist[[n]] = matrix(runif(layers_sizes[n+1]*layers_sizes[n], min = -0.5, max = 0.5),
                               nrow = layers_sizes[n+1], ncol = layers_sizes[n])
    blist[[n]] = matrix(runif(layers_sizes[n+1], min = -0.5, max = 0.5),
                               nrow = layers_sizes[n+1], ncol = 1)
  }
  
  wblist <- list(wlist, blist)
  
  return(wblist)
}
```

```{r}
logsumexp <- function (x) {
  y = max(x)
  y + log(sum(exp(x - y)))
}

softmax <- function (x) {
  exp(x - logsumexp(x))
}

ReLU <- function(Z) {
  return(pmax(Z, 0))
}

ReLU_deriv <- function(Z) {
  return(Z > 0)
}
```

```{r}
relu <- function(x){
  if(x > 0){return(x)}
  else{return(0)}
}
relu <- Vectorize(relu)

relu_matrix <- function(M){
  return(apply(M, 2, relu))
}

relu_deriv <- function(x){
  return((x > 0)*1)
}

softmax <- function(x){
  return(exp(x)/sum(exp(x)))
}

softmax_matrix <- function(M){
  return(apply(M, 2, softmax))
}

sum_vector <- function(M, Y){
  sum_norm <- function(x, y = Y){return(x+y)}
  return(apply(M, 2, sum_norm))
}

one_hot <- function(Y){
  one_hot_Y <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(Y))
  return(one_hot_Y)
}
```

```{r}
forward_prop <- function(wlist, blist, X){
    zlist <- list()
    alist <- list()
    n = length(wlist)
    
    
    
    Z <- (wlist[[1]] %*% X) |> sum_vector(blist[[1]])
    A <- relu_matrix(Z) 
    
    nA = nrow(A)
    ajuste = rep(-1/2, nA)
    A = A |> sum_vector(ajuste)
    
    
    zlist[[1]] = Z
    alist[[1]] = A
    
    
    if(length(wlist) - 1 >= 2)
    {
    for(i in 2:(length(wlist)-1)){
      Z = (wlist[[i]] %*% A) |> sum_vector(blist[[i]])
      A = relu_matrix(Z) 
      
      nA = nrow(A)
      ajuste = rep(-1/2, nA)
      A = A |> sum_vector(ajuste)
      
      zlist[[i]] = Z
      alist[[i]] = A
    }
    }
    
    
    
    Z = (wlist[[n]] %*% A) |> sum_vector(blist[[n]])
    A = softmax_matrix(Z) 
    
    nA = nrow(A)
    ajuste = rep(-1/2, nA)
    A = A |> sum_vector(ajuste)
    
    zlist[[n]] = Z
    alist[[n]] = A
    
    zalist = list(zlist, alist)
    
    return(zalist)
}
```

```{r}
backward_prop <- function(zlist, alist, wlist, X, Y){
  deriv_wlist = list()
  deriv_zlist = list()
  deriv_blist = list()
  m = ncol(X)
  
  zlist = rev(zlist)
  alist = rev(alist)
  wlist = rev(wlist)
  
  one_hot_Y = one_hot(Y) |> as.matrix() |> t()
  
  deriv_zlist[[1]] = alist[[1]] - one_hot_Y 

  deriv_wlist[[1]] = (1/m) * (deriv_zlist[[1]] %*% t(alist[[2]]))
  deriv_blist[[1]] = (1/m) * rowSums(deriv_zlist[[1]])
  
  if(length(zlist) - 1 >= 2)
  {
  for(n in 2:(length(zlist)-1)){
    deriv_zlist[[n]] = (t(deriv_wlist[[n-1]]) %*% deriv_zlist[[n-1]]) * ReLU_deriv(zlist[[n]])
    deriv_wlist[[n]] = (1/m) * deriv_zlist[[n]]  %*% t(alist[[n+1]])
    deriv_blist[[n]] = (1/m) * rowSums(deriv_zlist[[n]])
  }
  }
  
  n = length(zlist)
  
  deriv_zlist[[n]] = (t(deriv_wlist[[n-1]]) %*% deriv_zlist[[n-1]]) * ReLU_deriv(zlist[[n]])
  deriv_wlist[[n]] = (1/m) * (deriv_zlist[[n]]  %*% t(X))
  deriv_blist[[n]] = (1/m) * (rowSums(deriv_zlist[[n]]))
  
  
  deriv_wlist = rev(deriv_wlist)
  deriv_blist = rev(deriv_blist)
  
  return(list(deriv_wlist, deriv_blist))
}
```

```{r}
update_params <- function(wlist, blist, deriv_wlist, deriv_blist, alpha){
  teste <<- deriv_wlist
  m = length(wlist)
  for(n in 1:m){
    wlist[[n]] = wlist[[n]] - (alpha * deriv_wlist[[n]])
    blist[[n]] = blist[[n]] - (alpha * deriv_blist[[n]])
  }
  return(list(wlist, blist))
}
```

```{r}
get_predictions <- function(A2) {
  return(apply(A2, 2, which.max) - 1)
}

get_accuracy <- function(predictions, Y) {
  return(mean(predictions == Y))
}
```

```{r}
gradient_descent <- function(X, Y, hidden, alpha, iterations, modulo = 10){
  input_size = nrow(X)
  output_size = length(unique(Y))
  wblist = init_params(input_size, output_size, hidden)
  wlist = wblist[[1]]
  blist = wblist[[2]]
  
  for(i in 1:iterations){
    zalist = forward_prop(wlist, blist, X)
    zlist = zalist[[1]]
    alist = zalist[[2]]
    deriv_wblist = backward_prop(zlist, alist, wlist, X, Y)
    deriv_wlist = deriv_wblist[[1]]
    deriv_blist = deriv_wblist[[2]]
    wblist = update_params(wlist, blist, deriv_wlist, deriv_blist, alpha)
    wlist = wblist[[1]]
    blist = wblist[[2]]
    
    if(i %% modulo == 0){
      print(paste("Iteration:", i))
      predictions = get_predictions(alist[[length(alist)]])
      print(table(predictions))
      print(get_accuracy(predictions, Y))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(wlist, blist))
}
```

```{r}
shuffle <- sample(1:nrow(mnist_train), nrow(mnist_train))
X_train = mnist_train[shuffle,-1] |> as.matrix() |> t() 
X_train = X_train/255
Y_train = mnist_train[shuffle,1]  
```

```{r}
set.seed(236081)
corte = 10000
modulo = 5
wblist = gradient_descent(X = X_train[,1:corte], Y = Y_train[1:corte], hidden = c(10,10), alpha = 0.2, iterations = 1000, modulo)
```

```{r}
make_predictions <- function(X, wblist){
  wlist = wblist[[1]]
  blist = wblist[[2]]
  alist = forward_prop(wlist, blist, X)[[2]]
  A = alist[[length(alist)]]
  predictions = get_predictions(A)
  return(predictions)
}
```

```{r}
for(n in 1:100){
  print(make_predictions(X_train[,n], wblist))
}

```
